* chore: share the frontend .vue lint overrides from @packages/eslint-config

Add `frontendOverrides`, which app, launchpad and frontend-shared can
spread to keep the `.vue` rule that only allows type imports from
`@packages/data-context/*`. `vueTsxOverrides` and `baseConfig` already
cover the rest of `packages/frontend-shared/.eslintrc.json`.

`vue/no-v-html` stays an error. Two of the uses render text, not HTML,
so the B slices should switch them to `{{ }}` interpolation:

- frontend-shared `gql-components/error/BaseError.vue:99`: the error
  stack only has ANSI stripped, so `<` in an error message is parsed
  as markup.
- launchpad `setup/ManualInstall.vue:56`: dependency descriptions are
  plain text.

The rest need HTML and should get a commented disable:

- frontend-shared `BaseError.vue:62`, `warning/Warning.vue:14`,
  `composables/examples/UseMarkdownExample.vue:4` (markdown-it output)
- frontend-shared `components/ShikiHighlight.vue:56` (Shiki output)
- launchpad `setup/SelectFrameworkOrBundler.vue:35,75` (framework SVG
  icons)

app extends the same config and has four more uses for its slice:
`runs/RunsContainer.vue:42`, `settings/project/ExperimentRow.vue:27`,
`specs/banners/CloudMessageBanner.vue:20`, `runner/ScriptError.vue:5`
(markdown or error HTML).

The `defineProps`/`defineEmits`/`defineExpose`/`withDefaults` globals
are not carried over: eslint-plugin-vue 10 with vue-eslint-parser 10
defines the macros in `<script setup>`, and `no-undef` stays quiet on
them while still flagging an undefined control identifier.

* chore: tighten frontendOverrides and document the frontend migration

- Restrict value imports from the bare `@packages/data-context` entry
  in `.vue` files, not only its subpaths. No component imports it today.
- Note that `frontendOverrides` is spread after `baseConfig`, that a
  later `.vue` block setting the rule replaces its options, and why the
  rule stays on `.vue` files (the urql client imports browser-safe
  values from data-context).
- Add a migration guide section for app, launchpad and frontend-shared:
  what to spread, dropping the macro globals, and every `v-html` call
  site, split into the two to switch to interpolation and the ones to
  keep behind a commented disable.
- Realign the AGENTS.md architecture listing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WUv8r2KTDpE3ZZMw5JRnzt

* chore: align frontendOverrides comments with the code comment guidelines

Drop the "spread after `baseConfig`" note, which was wrong: `baseConfig`
never sets `@typescript-eslint/no-restricted-imports`, so spread order
does not matter. Move the two remaining reasons next to the lines they
explain and state them in present terms.
